_comment_chains: Observation registry for multi-chain watching (Phase 1, paper only). AJC is the SAME EVM address on every chain (EIP-7702, verified on Base+Monad). 'home' = the vault chain (executes for real); others are watch-only until execution infra is built per chain.

monad.name: monad
monad._note: public RPC has a tiny getLogs range cap; minimal backfill, follow forward

_comment_traders: OBSERVATION-ONLY additional profiles (paper, for testing data). watcher.py --trader <key> selects one of these; their trades go to trades_<key>.jsonl / copy_trades_<key>.jsonl, which the executor NEVER reads (and it also guards by the record's trader tag). NOT for execution — the live vault only ever mirrors the primary 'trader' above. Fill evm_address/solana_address once resolved + corroborated on-chain.

_comment_satellites: Per-chain Uniswap DEX config for satellite execution (keeper swaps its own USDC directly, no vault contract). Addresses verified on-chain. Add bnb/ethereum/monad/arc here as each is brought online.

bnb._note: usdc is Binance-Peg USDC (18 decimals!) — verified on-chain. weth is WBNB. PancakeSwap is deeper than Uniswap on BSC; validate pool liquidity in --dry-run before going live.

monad._note: Monad mainnet live since 2025-11-24, chain 143. usdc is native Circle USDC (6 decimals, CCTP V2). weth is WMON. Uniswap V3/V4 deployed (official docs). CONFIRM deBridge supports Monad before JIT funding via fundDestination — else fund via CCTP (cctp.py). Run --dry-run first.

_comment_cctp: Circle CCTP V2 rail (native USDC burn-and-mint). TokenMessengerV2/MessageTransmitterV2 are the same on all EVM chains (in cctp.py). Robinhood Chain has NO CCTP domain — it uses deBridge. Arc mainnet addresses publish at the Sept 16 launch; fill arc.rpc/usdc then and it works.

arc._note: fill rpc + native USDC address at Sept 16 mainnet launch

_comment_test_mode: sleeve.test_mode=true drops the bridge amortization floor to ~$1 so satellite JIT funding fires even for tiny trades — for proving the cross-chain path end-to-end when economics don't matter (you'll overpay the ~$4.50 deBridge fee vs the copy size). To bring a satellite live: set satellites.<chain>.live=true, owner setDestination(chainId, receiver=keeper 20b, takeToken=chain USDC, capBps) on the vault, ensure the chain is in ALCHEMY_CHAINS, then run satellite.py --chain <chain> --dry-run to validate routes before live. gas.refill_satellite_gas keeps native gas topped up on live satellites automatically.
_comment_treasury: v3 only. The vault mints AUM (management) + performance fee shares to the on-chain treasury address; treasury.py realizes that value and routes it to keeper gas and/or protocol-token buybacks. wallet empty => keeper (DEPLOYER); its key signs redeem+swaps (reuses PRIVATE_KEY when wallet==keeper). buyback stays dormant until buyback_token is set AND the owner has set a USDG->token route on the RouteAdapter. gas_pct + buyback_pct are normalized to 100.
